segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making the time. Sorry we couldn’t do earlier, I spent the morning cleaning duplicate account records in the CRM, so this was the first buyer call I could get to.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No worries. I’ve got 25 minutes. We’re trying to decide if the calibration module fits before our lab audit on May 20.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. For your 18 technicians and 6 supervisors, the standard plan would be 24 seats at $72 per seat per month, plus a one-time setup of $3,200. That includes the gauge schedule import and the certificate templates.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. We had 21 seats in the budget, so I need to check the overage. Can supervisors be read-only?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: They can. If 4 supervisors only need approvals and reports, we can put them on read-only at $22 per seat. That gets the monthly to $1,384 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s closer. Our finance team also asked for annual billing, net 45. Is that standard, or does it need approval?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Net 45 is fine at your contract size. Annual invoice would be $16,608, and the billing tool can split the setup fee onto the first invoice if that helps.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, do that. Go-live needs to be June 3, with our current spreadsheet loaded the week before.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that’s doable. Quick note, I’m entering pipeline notes and fixing required fields after this, so if I miss your 3 o’clock email I’ll still get the revised quote over by 4:30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Please include the June 3 go-live date and the read-only seat count, because my ops director will ask.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I also have a deal desk packet to assemble this afternoon, which is why I don’t have another live slot until Friday, but if questions come up just send them and I’ll answer in-line.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send the quote, and if legal doesn’t object to the data retention language, we can target signature by April 18.
